objective: 在R42已经正式冻结Qwen3-8B纯PD H0与H0+DNN residual预测以后，首次从六个受保护raw源重建12个blind完整窗口，用Phase40/41已验证teacher生成Hfull标签并做一次性盲测

execution.environment: local CPU worktree with explicit read-only external protected raw directory

blind_contract.evaluation_rule: join targets to the already committed R42 predictions by exact profile_id; no model, alpha, candidate, seed, feature, window or metric may change after target access

headline: calls_histogram_wape
bytes_histogram_wape
calls_total_wape
bytes_total_wape
mean_calls_histogram_tv
mean_normalized_log_payload_emd
metrics.composite: same four-ratio DNN/H0 score frozen by Phase42
metrics.improves_composite: composite_ratio < 1.0 and calls/bytes histogram WAPE ratios are each <=1.25
metrics.paired_bootstrap: 10000 deterministic profile-level resamples of H0 minus DNN mean per-profile calls-L1 and bytes-L1
metrics.negative_result_policy: workflow status remains PASS when integrity passes; scientific_outcome separately records improvement or non-improvement

raw_source_contract.committed_content: only names, bytes and SHA audits; never raw rows or complete request lists

supersession_note: The initial W43 run was rejected before preflight or target reconstruction because Python resolved Phase41 preflight.py instead of the local Phase43 module. W43-fix pins the local module path first; no blind target or result directory existed in the rejected attempt.
stop_and_block_if: HEAD is not exact W43, R42 predictions or checkpoint hashes differ, or Phase42 result manifest fails
any protected raw source hash differs or the 12 frozen window IDs cannot be reproduced exactly
reconstructed target-free features/H0 differ from the values frozen in Phase41
the evaluator would train, load a checkpoint, recompute predictions, change metrics or inspect targets before R42
a raw row, timestamp stream, input/output request pair list, model weight, cache or PID would enter Git
claim_boundary: Phase43 is a one-time blind evaluation for Qwen3-8B pure P1-D1 under the frozen bounded-wave communication semantics
12 profiles are confirmation evidence with uncertainty, not proof for the other five models
the result concerns topology-independent logical histograms, not physical RDMA time, latency, placement or online scheduling
